task.capability: single-resource CAS only; no cross-resource atomicity
task.goal: Restore target before values while preserving approved external writes, including same-value reauthorization. Never overwrite a superseding owner. Honor predicates after every recovery write. RECOVERED asserts configuration, not measured service health.
task.expression_language: A ref is [resource,field]. eq/ge/le compare two terms, sum adds terms, implies is logical implication. Literal scalars evaluate to themselves.
task.history_contract: complete=false or null provenance is unknown, not evidence of no intervening write.
